task: Author request: review the features3 logs (turn-based and real time, one session) for bad or broken decisions and functionality gaps, and bugfix; then (author requests) re-decide a provoking action, and make every ranged weapon type eligible for the Mixed weapon-set switch
author: Claude

inputs.commands: turn-based 213 issued; real-time 550 issued, 543 ended: 345 success, 56 interrupted after acting, 138 before acting, 4 fail
inputs.note: Raw logs stay private; only their fingerprints are recorded.

findings_fixed: Real time: a command dropped to decide again (HP loss, a new area, a new threat, an arrived walk, or alongside) was learnt from as a failure and barred for the turn. Fight 8: Wenduag's Griffon Aspect and then her Cure Critical Wounds potion (dropped at 34 -> 9 HP) were barred; she drank a smaller potion and died. A Cambion's walk out of a Locust Swarm was dropped and barred the same way. RealTimeTactics.ReconsiderPending keeps every dropped option open; a pending heal of the unit itself or a walk away is not dropped for an HP loss (RealTimeReplanRules).

Both modes: with Spellstrike on, the game delivers a Magus spell cast at an enemy through a weapon attack (Eldritch Archer: UnitUseAbility.OnAction queues a UnitAttack; melee touch: UnitUseAbility.CreateCastCommand). A dominated ally is an enemy to that test; the Drow Magus's Flare put four arrows at dominated Camellia (all missed) and one into dominated Wenduag (13). SparesTurnedAlly now spares such casts (DeliveredByWeapon, MagusSourceStrike); Spell Combat follow-ups are not priced at a turned ally.

Log: the [WeaponSet] note once per summon kind and never for natural-weapon creatures; abilities with an empty display name logged by blueprint name (AbilityDiscovery.LogName) in [Unused] and [Coverage].

Both modes (author report: Camellia and the Bandit had non-bow ranged weapons in another set): WeaponSlot.MaybeWeapon gives the empty-hand weapon (unarmed, natural) for any inactive slot, so F2 saw natural weapons only in every other set and never offered a switch. Sets are read by slot item (InactiveSetWeapon). Every ranged type is eligible: the 15 exported types of the Dart, Javelin, LightCrossbow, HeavyCrossbow, ThrowingAxe, Shortbow, Longbow and SlingStaff categories all have the game's Ranged attack type. The inactive weapon's enhancement was added twice (RuleCalculateWeaponStats applies an unwielded weapon's enchantments, ApplyEnchantmentsManually); removed. The game has no crossbow reload rule.

Real time (author-approved): a provoking action waiting to start in place (casting check, ranged shot, ray, thrown bomb, caster-provoking ability) is decided again when an enemy not counted when it was chosen now threatens the unit and can make an attack of opportunity (ShouldReplanOnNewThreat, ProvokesWhenThreatened, RealTimeReplanRules.ReplanForProvoke). The Drow Magus's death in real-time fight 7.

features3_observed.rage_decline: Knight Commander switched Accept Effect off in three turn-based fights (spells 375-502/rd against 0), the Derakni twice; both back on after the fight
features3_observed.performance: slowest decision 640 ms (Orvath, first decision of fight 1, 190 ms first threat reading) against 844 ms before; slow rows reuse 600-3500 damage estimates and 500-4600 effect chances; 28 decisions over 250 ms
features3_observed.group_teleport: Greater Teleport quoted with summons out (2 passengers, landing risk 0.0); lost to a weapon attack
features3_observed.weapon_sets: F2 never offered. The [WeaponSet] line said no other set held a weapon of the other kind, but it read the sets through WeaponSlot.MaybeWeapon, which shows inactive slots as empty-handed (fixed).
features3_observed.suggested_roles: applied to newly recruited characters only; saved settings kept
features3_observed.summon_control: on by default; 50 summon turns taken over in turn-based mode

observed_not_changed: Drow Magus death (real-time fight 7): whether her throw had started when the bites came is not in the log; the new re-decision covers a throw that had not started.
About 83 real-time commands ended before acting with no AI Control reason; several at once, many as their target died; probably the game's or the player's.
Coups de grace: 4 issued, 1 succeeded, 3 interrupted before acting (target dead or no longer helpless).
Domination: freeing offered (Dispel Magic 30) but Ki Shout on the Succubus (71) won; others used Daze and Command.
Grease scored up to 299 (area prone at DC 23 on low-Reflex brutes); consistent with the control model.
Incorporeal last enemies valued about 0 at difficulty 0.10 (easy-fight restraint).

checks.profile_audit: exit 0; new V0370-FEATURES3 14 checks passed (native WeaponSlot.MaybeWeapon and RuleCalculateWeaponStats contracts, the ranged weapon types of the exports); V0370-FEATURES' F2 estimate check follows the corrected contract; every other report line identical to features3
checks.external_members: 1 added (ItemSlot.get_MaybeItem, resolved by the audit against the supplied assembly), 1 removed (ItemSlot.get_Active, from the removed double-count)

limits: The re-decision fix is real time only; turn-based has no such drop rule.

A spell the game would deliver through the weapon is withheld at a dominated ally; it is not cast with Spellstrike switched off instead. Spells that are not delivered by a weapon (Daze, Command) are unchanged.
The other set's weapon is priced without its off hand, Rapid Shot or other attack modes, and without enchantments that act only through other rules than the weapon-stat rule: the estimate errs low.
The provoke re-decision covers commands that have not started; a cast already in its animation is left to finish.
